title: Signal: pnpm permits install scripts for specific packages
scope: A pnpm-lock.yaml file that declares an allowlist entry that lets a dependency run its build script.
limitations: It matches an allowlist entry that lets a dependency run its build script in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pnpm-lock.yaml that mentions an allowlist entry that lets a dependency run its build script in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
